offers_valid_schedule.name: offers_valid_schedule
offers_valid_schedule.value: "offers"."ends_at" IS NULL OR "offers"."starts_at" IS NULL OR "offers"."ends_at" > "offers"."starts_at"

order_status_events_transition_valid.name: order_status_events_transition_valid
order_status_events_transition_valid.value: ("order_status_events"."from_status" IS NULL AND "order_status_events"."to_status" = 'received') OR ("order_status_events"."from_status" IN ('received', 'approved', 'rejected', 'preparing', 'ready', 'delivering', 'completed') AND "order_status_events"."to_status" IN ('received', 'approved', 'rejected', 'preparing', 'ready', 'delivering', 'completed') AND "order_status_events"."from_status" <> "order_status_events"."to_status")
